method: Read all ten complete primary opinions from the saved PDF text layers, including separate opinions. Matched every saved PDF SHA-256 to the evidence hash in the ledger. Compared identity, role, date, own trial action and reported reasoning, appellate treatment and cited paragraphs. Six opinions were read by the assigned reviewer; four by an independent delegated reader. Search snippets and ledger summaries did not substitute for reading the opinions.

limitations: This review verifies the historical decisions and source attribution, not a complete later docket or citator history. No independent subsequent-appeal search was performed by this review team.
Publication-status labels were not treated as proof that all litigation is concluded.
No selected outcome supports a numerical ideology score or an overall Republican, Democratic or Trump-alignment label.
Saved primary PDF text layers were read; the PDFs were not freshly downloaded by this second reader. Cryptographic hashes confirm they are the files identified in the evidence ledger.
